from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

def transform(grid):
    a=[list(row) for row in grid]
    cw=[list(row) for row in zip(*a[::-1])]
    ccw=[list(row) for row in zip(*a)][::-1]
    rot180=[row[::-1] for row in a[::-1]]
    return [a[r]+cw[r] for r in range(len(a))]+[ccw[r]+rot180[r] for r in range(len(a))]

test=[[1,6,6,6,6,6,5,6],[7,3,6,7,3,6,5,6],[6,6,6,6,6,6,5,1],[6,4,6,5,6,6,6,6],[3,4,6,4,7,1,5,6],[6,5,6,3,6,6,6,5],[4,3,6,6,6,6,6,6],[6,4,6,4,6,5,1,1]]
out=transform(test)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out))
